appDesc.message: Automatically pauses audio in your other tabs when one starts playing, so you never hear two sounds at once. Works on any site.

subtitle.message: When a tab starts playing, the others pause.

modeAllDesc.message: Any tab that plays pauses the rest.

modeSitesDesc.message: The rule applies only between the domains in the list.

sitesEmptyHint.message: Add at least 2 sites to apply the rule between.

statusAllTabs.message: On · one tab at a time.

invalidDomain.message: This tab has no valid domain.

exceptionsDesc.message: Tabs from these sites won't pause the others when they play sound. Useful for short notifications, like WhatsApp Web.

exceptionsEmptyHint.message: Add sites whose sound you want to ignore (e.g. notifications).
